title: Decant report, schemaVersion 1
description: A shape-only report about one cleaned link. It carries no link, no parameter values and no path. The relay rejects anything that does not match, extra fields included.

reportId.description: Random UUID v4 (lowercase), made fresh for each report and never reused across reports. A retried send repeats the same ID and is stored once. The relay keeps it only as long as the raw report.

reasons.description: Why the person reports the link: tracker-kept (a tracking parameter was not removed), link-broke (the cleaned link stopped working), or both. One or two unique values.

host.description: Lowercase host name of the link. No scheme, port, path, user info or IP address (the last label must start with a letter).

appVersion.description: Marketing version of the app that sent the report: two or three dotted numbers, each 1 to 4 digits (for example 1.4 or 1.4.2).

appBuild.description: Build number of the app that sent the report.

date.description: Calendar day of the report (YYYY-MM-DD), rounded to the day by the sender. Checked for shape only; the relay stores its own receive day.

rulesGeneration.description: Generation number of the rule set the app used, so a report is read against the right rules. Monotonic counter from decant-rules, starting at 1.

parameters.description: Every parameter of the link the report is about, at most 32. Each says what happened to it and whether the person flagged it.

note.description: Optional free text typed by the user, sent exactly as typed. 1 to 280 characters (Unicode code points), no control characters except tab and newline, and no line or paragraph separators, bidirectional overrides or unpaired surrogates.

name.description: Parameter name. Limited character set: no '=', '/', '@', '%' or spaces, so a value or path cannot be written into it.

outcome.description: removed-by-rules: the rules removed it. removed-by-you: it was kept by the rules and the person removed it. kept: it stayed in the link. restored-by-you: the rules removed it and the person put it back. The link ends without the removed-* parameters and with the others.

flagged.description: true when the person ticked this parameter in the report as the one they mean.

shape.description: What the value looked like, never the value. charset is the narrowest class that holds every character, in this order: empty, digits, hex (a-f and 0-9, lowercase), alpha (a-z, A-Z), alnum (a-z, A-Z, 0-9), base64url (alnum plus '-' and '_'), other. empty and length 0 go together.
